common: Production15-frame animation source atlas for our browser game. Original rich16-bit pixel-art redraw closely based on ACTUAL Plants vs Zombies SEA-SHROOM shown in reference1; reference2 gives approved navy stepped contours, saturated dimensional color ramps and crisp pixel rendering. EXACT FIVE columns x THREE rows,15complete separated poses in equal square cells, constant scale/design, generous margins, entire cap/nozzle/root fringe fits. All faceRIGHT three-quarter view. Uniform pale cream background, no text/borders/ground/water/puddles/shadows/particles/detached spores/projectiles. Canonical anatomy: broad DARK GREEN domed mushroom CAP with a few large darker green round SPOTS, pale MINT/AQUA short mushroom STALK/BODY, two friendly black oval eyes with white glints below cap rim, short forward GREEN TRUMPET NOZZLE pointingRIGHT. Stalk flares continuously down into a flat footless cyan base with a few short flowing aqua basal ROOT FRONDS, like actual reference. Fronds are attached plant anatomy, not drawn water, tentacle legs or shoes. Never add human arms/legs/feet/hands or a separate leaf pedestal. Keep cap, stem and trumpet recognizable, not a fish, frog, helmet on a person, or generic jellyfish. EXACT cell poses: ROW1col1 IDLEA;row1col2 IDLEB gentle cap/body breathe;row1col3 WALK1 rooted/frond glide right with cap tilt;row1col4 WALK2 stalk flex and frond sweep;row1col5 WALK3 opposite frond slide still facingRIGHT. ROW2col1 WALK4 settle;row2col2 ATTACKWINDUP cap/stalk draw back and tube compresses;row2col3 ATTACKRELEASE nozzle thrusts and widens toRIGHT, cap rim flexes, no projectile;row2col4 ATTACKRECOVERY tube/cap relax;row2col5 HURT one flinch with squeezed eyes and wrinkled cap. ROW3col1 KO1 both eyesFULLYCLOSED as curved eyelids, cap/stalk droop toward continuous root base;row3col2 KO2 both eyesFULLYCLOSED and lower cap rests close over folded base, more compact thanKO1. Row3col3 CHEER1 HAPPY upward-crescent eye arcs, cap/frond fringe lifts;row3col4 CHEER2 different happy-eye cap lift and frond opening;row3col5 SLEEP both eyesFULLYCLOSED as downward curved eyelids, cap droops calmly over stem/base. Mouth is only the natural trumpet, no extra smile underneath. All15 distinct drawn poses; no transform-only repeated stills.

variants.desc: Stage0 SEA-SHROOM: match actual compact mushroom with low round dark green spotted dome, short pale-aqua flared stalk, small right-facing green trumpet, two black eyes, short attached pale-cyan root fringe. Simple canonical compact silhouette. No waves, crown, additional cap layers or royal decorations.

Stage1 TIDE-SHROOM, project natural evolution: broader DARK GREEN spotted cap with a softly WAVY scalloped cap rim edged pale aqua, slightly stronger pale mint stalk and longer but still short attached aqua basal root fronds. Cap remains a mushroom dome, not a curling water wave or separate hat; preserve large round dark spots and right-facing trumpet. Fuller frill/vein detail makes stage1 distinct. Same friendly eyes, no feet or detached water.

Stage2 OCEAN-SHROOM, project final evolution: lush broad mushroom cap in rich dark green with deeper teal-green large round spots, a stronger double scalloped AQUA rim/frill and richer cyan underside. Somewhat taller pale-mint continuous stalk with wider rooted flare and flowing short aqua ROOT FROND fringe, no jellyfish legs. Larger stronger right-facing green trumpet. Natural expanded aquatic mushroom, no coral crown, ocean backdrop, waves, limbs, crown or detached effects. Cap still dominates silhouette.
